label: Gallant River / Deep Brook confluence
point_definition: Eastern tributary enters the north-south river above its separate downstream road crossing.
identity_evidence: The river approaches from the north beside the road; the road turns east while the river continues south to meet an eastern tributary. Below the junction the river bends southwest across a separate road crossing and continues west. The upstream eastern branch and neighbouring road configuration match the original network. The junction is visible east of the separate sawmill symbol, not at that symbol or at the lower road crossing.
phase: Fresh independent validation of frozen TPS13; excluded from fitting and selection
